# Test photos

Sample images from the OpenCV projects, used only to test detection and matching logic:

- `lena.jpg`: opencv/opencv `samples/data/lena.jpg`
- `messi.jpg`: opencv/opencv `samples/data/messi5.jpg` (face too small to pass the quality check; kept for reference)
- `david1.jpg`, `david2.jpg`: opencv/opencv_extra `testdata/cv/face/` (two photos of the same person, 320x240)

None of these are AD TECH interns. Do not add real intern photos to the repo.
